n_subjects: 20 patients x multiple timepoints x multiple matrices
instrument: Unknown - likely QTOF or Orbitrap; check MassIVE page
institution: UCSD and Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai
extra_info: 4-week ITIS anti-inflammatory diet pilot (NCT05559463), 20 knee OA patients, published Nutrients 2025 (doi:10.3390/nu17172729). Multi-matrix = plasma + saliva + stool, each collected before and after intervention. Responders (n=8) vs non-responders (n=12) is secondary contrast. Microbiome data also deposited (PRJNA1159155) but not needed here. This is the only multi-matrix dataset in D_both - unique opportunity to compare omeprazole/5-OH-OMP ratio across biofluids in the same subjects.
reason: Multi-matrix paired design. Each matrix asks a different biological question. Highest power within-study contrast.
notes_curation: KEEP ALL MATRICES - process separately per matrix. Plasma: parent/metabolite ratio (CYP2C19 signal). Saliva: oral bioavailability / first-pass angle. Stool: gut-microbial transformation angle. Before/after design is paired within-subject = most powerful statistical design in the collection. Separate files by SampleType column. Note that with only n=20 subjects, power for between-subject contrasts (responder vs non-responder) is low - focus on within-subject before/after ratio change.
within_study_contrast: Before vs after diet (paired within-subject); responder vs non-responder
